Cc: procurement@emberhealth.com
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: DPA + cross-border controls for pilot

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — Ember's security and procurement teams want to move toward a short pilot but need to get DPA terms and transfer safeguards scoped before we sign any contract. Attached is a consolidated checklist from our side and a couple of questions we need aligned: 

- Will Redwood accept the standard SCCs (EU) plus the UK IDTA/UK Addendum for UK-resident data?
- For the pilot telemetry/logging, can you confirm subprocessor list and whether any cloud egress crosses non-EU/UK jurisdictions?
- We have a procurement cadence goal of getting legal sign-off and a PoC SOW signed within the next 10 business days — what is feasible on your side?

Requested attachments from Ember: initial DPA template, ingestion data sample description (we can share after NDA).

Can you loop in whoever will handle the DPA redline and SCC mapping?

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Park
Legal Counsel, Ember Health

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@emberhealth.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA + cross-border controls for pilot

Hi Sarah — thanks, and glad the demo went well. Looping in Chloe (Privacy Ops) and Markus (AM) to handle the DPA and procurement timeline. We looked through the checklist and have a short proposal: 

1) DPA approach: we can sign SCCs + UK IDTA/UK Addendum. We will provide a clean DPA and a redline for your legal to review.
2) Subprocessors: we will attach the current subprocessor CSV and an SCC mapping workbook. None of the standard infra subprocessors route production customer data outside of designated regions by default; details below.
3) Cadence: for a 10-business-day target we recommend: 
   - Day 0: we exchange initial redlines (we will send today).
   - Day 2: 1st legal-to-legal pass (DocuSign placeholders ok).
   - Day 5: technical evidence handoff (SCC mapping + network egress snapshot).
   - Day 8–10: final sign and SOW execution.

I've attached our redline and SCC mapping workbook so you can see the proposed carveouts and the region routing table. If Ember needs an on-prem or VPC-only carveout for the pilot, flag that now so we can include it in the SOW.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Privacy & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Ember_DPA_Redline_20261027.pdf (PDF, 120KB); Redwood_SCCs_Mapping_20261027.xlsx (XLSX, 200KB)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Ember DPA — proposed redlines and evidence plan

Chloe / Markus — quick coordination before I send the formal DocuSign route: 

Summary of redline highlights (see attached PDF):
- Clarified flow-down for Dedicated vs Hosted; pilot will default to Hosted in us-west unless they require VPC.
- Added explicit TIA/DTIA evidence bucket requirement for any UK-addendum scope (samples, network egress map).
- Strengthened logging retention limits for telemetry data used for debugging (30 days auto, with audit export on request).
- Fallback policy: automatic model-variant fallback is called out; need to ensure legal understands cached KV lifetimes.

Evidence we need to hand off to Ember legal/infosec:
- SCC mapping workbook (attached)
- Subprocessor CSV (current export) — I pulled a snapshot and attached it to the Drive link.
- Network egress snapshot for the last 30 days (ops to produce)

Action items: 
- Chloe: prepare a concise TIA packet (2–3 pages) summarizing safeguards and the SCC+UK Addendum coverage. Aim EOD Thu (2026-10-29).
- Markus: confirm whether Ember is ok with the Hosted pilot or if they will request VPC-only (we'll need pricing/lead time).

I'll draft the DocuSign envelope after Chloe confirms the TIA packet content.

— Rachel
